/bin/bash -lc "cat > tmp/infer_abo.py <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from io import StringIO

def variants(path):
 with open(path) as f:
  hdr=next(f)
  rows=[l for l in f if 133250000<=int(l.split('\\t',2)[1])<=133280000]
 return pd.read_csv(StringIO(hdr+''.join(rows)),sep='\\t')
p=variants('match.genotypes.1.1.pvar')
r=variants('match.genotypes.1.3.pvar')
t=pd.read_csv('tmp/target.raw',sep='\\t')
z=pd.read_csv('tmp/reference.raw',sep='\\t')
shared=p.merge(r,on=['#CHROM','POS','REF','ALT'],suffixes=('_target','_ref'))
tcols=[a+'_'+b for a,b in zip(shared.ID_target,shared.REF)]
rcols=[a+'_'+b for a,b in zip(shared.ID_ref,shared.REF)]
X=z[rcols].to_numpy(float)
T=t[tcols].to_numpy(float)
for c in ['9:133255928_C','9:133255935_G','9:133257521_T']:
 y=z[c].to_numpy(float)
 with np.errstate(invalid='ignore',divide='ignore'):
  corr=np.array([np.corrcoef(X[:,i],y)[0,1] for i in range(X.shape[1])])
 best=np.argsort(-np.nan_to_num(np.abs(corr)))[:12]
 print('\\nMissing REF count',c)
 for i in best:
  print(shared.iloc[i].POS,tcols[i],round(corr[i],4),'target',T[:,i].astype(int).tolist(), 'reference table',pd.crosstab(X[:,i],y).to_dict())
PY
python3 tmp/infer_abo.py"
